name: codementor-ai
description: AI-powered coding interview and assessment platform

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @codementor/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @codementor/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @codementor/api && npm run build -w @codementor/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
